title: Mia and Her Brother
text:
Mia has a red ball. She plays with it in the park. Her brother has a blue kite. He likes to fly it on windy days.

Mia and her brother play games together at home. They play a board game after dinner. Mia always wins. Her brother says it is not fair.

questions.text: What do Mia and her brother play after dinner?
options: A video game in the park

questions.text: How does Mia's brother probably feel when Mia always wins?
Why do you think Mia's brother likes windy days?
options: His kite flies well when it is windy
He does not like the sun
It is too cold to play

vocabulary.definition: a light toy that flies in the air on a string
when there is a lot of wind
is the best player and gets the victory

paragraph_translations: Mia tem uma bola vermelha. Ela brinca com ela no parque. Seu irmão tem uma pipa azul. Ele gosta de empinar a pipa em dias ventosos.
Mia e seu irmão brincam de jogos juntos em casa. Eles jogam um jogo de tabuleiro depois do jantar. Mia sempre ganha. O irmão dela diz que não é justo.
